note: Root-level suites under src/__tests__/integration that no workflow runs. This list is the OPPOSITE of its siblings. They guard a directory a workflow names, so their default is INCLUDED and a new suite runs the day it lands. This root is enumerated file by file — naming the directory would also run every red subdirectory under it — so the default here is EXCLUDED, and a file nobody enumerated is silently unrun. Before this list existed, the only record of the carve-out was a workflow comment counting how many were red. A count cannot fail. Triaged under backlog item 26 on 2026-09-23, with all five measured red on origin/main 5566a8df0: 13 failing cases of 28. THE LIST IS NOW EMPTY (T-477, 2026-09-25): the last three entries were repaired and wired into the integration-suites jest command, so every root-level file under this directory is run by a pull-request job and the ceiling is 0. Keep this file. An empty list is not a dead control — it is the strongest state of the one in checkRoot's case 1: with the default inverted, the next root file anybody adds and does not wire is unrun, undeclared and silent, and this checker is the only thing that says so.
howToClear: Repair the suite, add its exact path to the jest command in .github/workflows/integration-suites.yml, delete the entry here, and lower CEILING in check-integration-root-quarantine.mjs in the SAME change. The checker re-runs every entry and fails if one PASSES, so an entry whose reason has been fixed cannot sit here quietly, and the ratchet fails when the list is shorter than the ceiling, so clearing one cannot leave headroom for the next. Do NOT clear an entry by deleting the failing case: four of these five are stale assertions about contracts that genuinely moved, and the fifth is a live defect that this suite is the only thing catching.
verdicts: update = the suite asserts a contract that has legitimately changed and the assertion needs rewriting to the current one. delete = the suite covers something the product retired, and removing it is a deliberate scope removal that must say so in a release record. real = the suite is correct and the product is wrong; the owner item carries the fix, and the suite stays red until it lands.
